Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit Appointed Vice Chief of Air Staff

Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit has taken charge as the new Vice Chief of the Indian Air Force. He is noted as a strategist behind 'Operation Sindoor'. His appointment is expected to guide the future direction of the Air Force.
